prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Home new flow changes have proven helpful, winning 2 out of 4 tests.

Changes:
0: [home, new_flow] Desktop pet interaction preview new flow on waiting screen: Adds an interactive pet preview control sub-flow on the waiting screen that lets users practice dragging and interacting with their mascot while rendering finishes. (why: Waiting step mean duration is 2336s, and support received 3 complaints from users unsure how to control or talk to their desktop pet.)
1: [sign_in, redesign] Account pet save status badge redesign on sign-in screen: Redesigns the sign-in screen into a spotlight layout showcasing cloud pet save security badges. (why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again, while sign-in redesigns have proven winning in previous tests.)
2: [choose_path, new_screen] Interactive pet personality teaser new screen in choose path: Inserts a new preview screen right before choose_path that highlights unique pet behavior styles. (why: Choose path drop-off is 78.9% with a long mean duration of 514s; engaging users early helps set path intent.)
3: [adoption, redesign] Two column adoption certificate showcase redesign: Redesigns the adoption_certificate screen into a two-column layout highlighting pet traits alongside adoption details. (why: Adoption step drops to 68.5% conversion with 89s median duration, requiring stronger visual confirmation.)
4: [finish, hint] Desktop control shortcuts card hint on home intro: Displays a visible control hint card on the home intro screen detailing mouse shortcuts for hiding and interacting with the desktop pet. (why: Finish completion drops to 64.8% and support received 3 emails regarding confusion over controlling or hiding desktop pets.)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop launch progress wait info on waiting screen: Displays active desktop engine initialization status text on the waiting screen while pet files compile. (why: Support received 3 emails about pets not appearing on the desktop, while waiting screen median time takes 201s.)
6: [adoption, copy] Photo quality and alignment guidance copy in photo upload screen: Updates headline and body copy on the photo upload screen with explicit lighting and pose recommendations. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or visual distortion after photo upload.)
7: [finish, layout] Full bleed visual layout for home intro screen: Changes the home intro screen layout to full_bleed to present the finalized desktop pet prominently. (why: Finish step drop-off is 64.8% with a long median time of 395s; visual layout updates improve completion momentum.)
8: [adoption, incentive] Custom pet photo validation highlight badge in adoption: Adds a high-accuracy photo verification badge component to the photo upload screen. (why: Addresses custom pet rendering failure reports (3 support emails) while reassuring users about generation quality.)
9: [home, notification] Completion alert notification on waiting screen: Enables notify_when_ready on the waiting screen so users receive a notification when background rendering finishes. (why: Waiting step mean duration is 2336s, causing users to switch away and stall before reaching the finish step.)
